title: E numa lah
style: Trance with atmospheric pads, pulsing sub-bass, rolling bassline, cascading synth arpeggios and crystalline plucks; euphoric supersaw drops over a massive kick, with stripped-back percussion in the breakdown. Full chorus layering, warm synth echoes and gentle breathy delay. Driving 150 BPM festival pulse; the user's recorded male baritone leads the builds, opening into female soprano vocals in the drops.
lyrics:
[Intro — Atmospheric pads, pulsing sub-bass, 150 BPM — both]

(E dem chi laim)
(Siman de yacken)

[Build 1 — Rolling bassline, cascading synth arpeggios, white noise sweeps — baritone]

Direch vi numa lah
E numa lah
Laim de inkera bah
Ox mint de baiya
Limpter vi, limpter vi
E numa lah

[Drop 1 — Euphoric supersaw leads, massive kick drum, peak festival energy — soprano]

Surrender to the night!
Let the light ignite!
No more words to say!
We are alive today!
Direch vi numa lah!
E numa lah!

[Breakdown — Build 2 — Stripped-back percussion, deep ambient chords, crystalline synth plucks — baritone]

The night is long and unending

Where wakefulness is a dream
And memories crowd our minds
Crushing what we used to believe
Some things cannot be thought
They must simply flow through life
Without any analysis or reason
Just admire the pure beauty
Do not think
Do not speak

[Drop 2 — Maximum energy surge, soaring melodies, full chorus layering — soprano]

Surrender to the night!
Let the light ignite!
No more words to say!
We are alive today!
Direch vi numa lah!
E numa lah!

[Outro — Fading drums, warm synth echoes, gentle breathy delay — both]

(Do not think)
(Do not speak)
(E numa lah...)
